pages.text: $(bold)Bosses' Rise$() drops four souls-like encounters into the world as structures. They don't mark themselves on your map. You find them by exploring — and you'll know when you've found one.$(br2)$(bold)Dragon$() — Aerial, fire-breathing. The fight is about windows: survive the dives, punish the landings. Drops Dragon Armor — Netherite-tier with innate fire resistance. May require multiple kills for a full set.

$(bold)Yeti$() — Ice attacks and brutal knockback. Rewards aggression and punishes standing still. Drops Yeti Armor and ice-infused weapons.$(br2)$(bold)Sand Worm$() — Surfaces from desert ground without warning, poisons on contact. Drops Sand Worm Armor and unique weapons.$(br2)$(bold)Knight$() — High defense, relentless melee. A fight of patience and pattern recognition. Drops the full Knight Armor set.

$(bold)Approach:$() These are designed as souls-like encounters. Vanilla hit-trading will get you killed. Use Epic Fight's battle mode — dodge timing matters. Holy spells from Iron's Spellbooks are strong sustain picks for long fights.$(br2)Drops are not guaranteed per kill. Come prepared for multiple runs. These hits are heavy.
